importantAbilities.name: Rage
importantAbilities.text: Bonus action. +2 damage on melee, resistance to physical damage. Lasts 1 minute.

importantAbilities.name: Reckless Attack
importantAbilities.text: Advantage on melee Strength attacks this turn, but attacks against him have advantage too.

importantAbilities.name: Channel Divinity
importantAbilities.text: 1/short rest. Various clerical effects depending on chosen domain.

importantAbilities.name: Spirit Guardians
importantAbilities.text: 3rd level spell. Spirits flit around her, radiant or necrotic damage to enemies within 15 ft.

importantAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
importantAbilities.text: Once per turn, +3d6 damage on an attack with advantage or with an ally adjacent to the target.

importantAbilities.name: Cunning Action
importantAbilities.text: Bonus action to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.
